aic.basis: AI credits of errored invocations (measured), of linked follow-up invocations (causal), or the mean healthy-invocation cost (statistical)

latency_ms.basis: wall-clock duration recorded on the failing tool call or invocation

tokens.basis: token classes of the attributed invocations

tool_calls.basis: counted friction occurrences that consumed a tool call

turns.basis: one additional turn per errored or retried model invocation

groups.rule: highest-fidelity source owns overlapping occurrences; lower-fidelity sources contribute only their excess
